File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update splitFields to treat unescaped quotes or quotes not at the start of a field as ordinary characters rather than opening a quoted field, or handle unquoted fields containing inch marks properly so that csv parsing does not fail on unquoted quotes.
args.title: Fix CSV parser failing on unquoted inch marks / quotes in fields

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The CSV parser expects quotes to start fields or be escaped, causing unquoted inch marks (e.g. 27") in unquoted CSV fields to incorrectly toggle quote state and break row parsing.
